interpretation: Primary edges comprise 4 upper/lower arm segments and 30 finger segments. Palm and trunk distances are separately reported proxies, not all assumed rigid bones.
cautions: Index mapping is dataset-specific and applied to both predictions and references.
Finger subjoint names rely on released branch order and visible chains; upstream construction code is absent.
No facial edges are evaluated as rigid bones.
No automatic inverse z-score is performed.
